title: Wanderlust 3D: Global Destination Explorer
description: A production-ready, zero-build travel atlas covering 3 regions and 15 curated destinations (Japan, Italy, Costa Rica), with verified Unsplash photography, a three-slide hero, live search and interest/budget filters, destination modals with deep links, three signature routes, a persistent localStorage itinerary, 81 headless checks and a GitHub Pages release.

build.includes: Orientation and GitHub auth check; content architecture; visual curation of 24 Unsplash images; 15 researched destination guides; full HTML/CSS/JS application; responsive and accessibility fixes; 81-check headless verification; image reachability audit; 9 generated screenshots plus a 1200x630 social card; README and 6 release docs; 404/manifest/icon/robots/sitemap; GitHub repository, Pages workflow and live deployment; reusable skill packaged and published to the OpenCode skills catalog.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record at 2026-11-06T04:20:10Z. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are context-usage figures and are reported separately. operatorNotes.githubAuth: Reused the existing macOS Keychain credential through git's osxkeychain helper; one credential read was used for the REST API calls and repeated pushes did not produce new prompts.
